title: Trump says Iran peace deal could be reached ‘soon’ after Tehran reopens Hormuz Strait
summary: Tehran's announcement on Friday that the critical Strait of Hormuz was reopen to commercial shipping for the remainder of the Israel-Lebanon ceasefire was followed by a flurry of social media posts by US President Donald Trump suggesting that a peace deal could be reached "soon".
